$comment: all: every unique parameter name across routine_params.json. excluded: not real sweep candidates (data = the arrays themselves; size = already the primary sweep axis in every benchmark). sweepCandidates: the remaining 16, grouped by role -- OFAT screen targets for "does this secretly affect speed at fixed size". priority: expected effect size, from reading every .wgsl shader this session (high = changes the whole memory access pattern; medium = padding/coalescing on one buffer; low = one branch or a single value never special-cased by any shader). Each sweepCandidate carries the `baseline` it is pinned to while another parameter is swept (one-factor-at-a-time), the `levels` its own sweep walks, and why those levels. Values are read from benchmarks/<routine>/, not aspirational.

incx.note: Baseline 1 is already measured by the main benchmark, so the sweep skips it; the three levels are one point per coalescing regime.

incy.note: Swept together with incx in the same stride.<routine> file.

lda.note: Row byte-stride is ld*4: 0/32/64/128 stay on the 128-byte boundary, 1/8/16/48 break it.

ldb.note: As lda. sgemm's ldb sweep is a combined transB x pad grid, not a plain one.

ldc.note: As lda, on the output matrix — write coalescing rather than read bandwidth.

diag.note: unit skips the diagonal load, and the reciprocal in a solve.

trans.note: Routines with a single matrix operand (ssyrk, ssyr2k, strmv, strsv).

transA.note: Level 3 routines with two matrix operands.

transB.note: Streamed along the inner loop, so the likelier of the two to matter.

uplo.note: Decides whether the heavy rows dispatch first or last; ~1.7-1.8x on ssyr/ssyr2.

layout.note: wgblas-only — cuBLAS is column-major and has no layout argument.

alpha.baselineNote: 2.0 in the Level 1 benchmarks (sscal, saxpy); 1.0 elsewhere
alpha.note: Levels target branches a kernel could have, not a range. Inert unless the shader branches on it; strsm does.

beta.note: beta = 0 permits skipping the read of C/y, so unlike alpha this can be non-flat.

c.note: Cosine half of srot's rotation, swept with s pinned.

s.note: Sine half of srot's rotation, swept with c pinned.
